title: 第9章 要功法第10章 财侣法地
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 几天后的午后，书阁内一如既往的安静。
李叶青盘膝坐在窗下的蒲团上，心神沉入识海。
这几天莲公主没来，李叶青也终于清静下来，全副身心钻入书籍之中。
那卷《太上老君常说清静经》的文字如同涓涓细流，在他心间缓缓淌过，解析进度终于突破了某个节点，达到了25100。
一种难以言喻的清明感悄然浮现，并非知识的直接增加，而更像是一层笼罩在心灵上的薄纱被轻轻拂去。
他感觉自己的思绪比以往更加凝练，对外界的感知也似乎敏锐了一些。
这《清静经》果然不凡，解析带来的并非具体的技能，而更像是一种根基性的滋养。
就在这时，熟悉的脚步声由远及近，周刘培提着一个新的食盒，脸上带着惯有的笑容，但眼神里却多了几分不同往日的机警和……兴奋？
“青哥！我来了！”
周刘培熟门熟路地凑过来，将食盒放在小几上，压低声音，“今儿个可有新鲜事儿！”
李叶青从那种玄妙的状态中脱离，睁开眼，给他倒了杯水“看你这样子，宫里又起风了？”
“何止是起风，简直是风向大变！”
周刘培咕咚喝了一大口水，抹了把嘴，神秘兮兮地说，“首先第一桩，皇后娘娘的病，好了！”
李叶青心中一动，面色不变“哦？这是好事。太医们找到对症的方子了？”
“是不是太医的方子不清楚，”
周刘培眨眨眼，“但宫里都在传，是莲公主不知从哪儿找来了一张古方，献给了皇后娘娘，这才药到病除。
而且啊，皇后娘娘病愈后，昨日一早就去了慈宁宫给太后请安，气色看着竟比病前还要好些！
太后老人家很是高兴，赏了不少东西。”
李叶青默默听着，这正在他预料之中。
“这第二桩嘛，”
周刘培声音压得更低，“就跟长春宫那位有关了。你猜怎么着？就在前几日的经筵讲学上，三皇子殿下向主讲的老翰林请教古籍中的医药典故，也不知怎么，就聊到了一些药性猛烈、能让人产生忽冷热热症状的罕见药材和方子上去了……虽然没提具体是谁，但当时在场的几位老大臣，还有陛下，可都听着呢！
随后献上了自己找到的一个药方，说是以之为基础调配药草可以得到增装血气的丹药，虽然痛苦，但是可以提升武者实力。
被皇上赞赏了一番，据说当场升了亲王爵位。”
李叶青指尖轻轻敲击着桌面。
姬昭动作不慢，而且方式很巧妙，经筵之上，借学问探讨之名，看似无意，实则有心地将“特定症状与特定药物”这个信息传递了出去。
皇帝只要不是太昏聩，心里必然会留下印象。
“然后呢？长春宫那边有什么反应？”
“反应？”周刘培撇撇嘴，
“好像没什么反应啊。”
这是在清理痕迹，还是加快行动？
李叶青暗忖。
端妃那边显然也察觉到了风险，开始应对了。
只能说不愧是端妃，对面都已经做到这种地步了，仍旧是不急不缓、行事密不透风。
content_en:
In the afternoon a few days later, the library was as quiet as ever.
Li Yeqing sat cross-legged on the futon under the window, his mind sinking into the sea of ​​consciousness.
Princess Lian has not been here these days, and Li Yeqing finally calmed down and immersed himself in books.
The text of the "Tai Shang Laojun often said the Jingjing Sutra" was like a trickle, slowly flowing through his heart, and the analysis progress finally broke through a certain node and reached 25,100.
An indescribable sense of clarity quietly emerged, not a direct increase in knowledge, but more like a veil covering the soul being gently brushed away.
He felt that his thoughts were more condensed than before, and his perception of the outside world seemed to be sharper.
This "Qing Jing Sutra" is indeed extraordinary. What the analysis brings is not specific skills, but more like a kind of fundamental nourishment.
At this moment, familiar footsteps approached from far away. Zhou Liupei was carrying a new food box with his usual smile on his face, but his eyes were a little more alert and... excited?
"Brother Qing! I'm coming!"
Zhou Liupei came over in a familiar manner, put the food box on the small table, and lowered his voice, "There is something new today!"
Li Yeqing broke away from that mysterious state, opened his eyes, and poured him a glass of water. "Looking at you like this, is there another wind in the palace?"
"It's not just the wind that's blowing, it's the wind that's changing direction!"
Zhou Liupei took a sip of water, wiped his mouth, and said mysteriously, "First of all, the Queen's illness is cured!"
Li Yeqing's heart moved, but his expression remained unchanged, "Oh? This is a good thing. Have the imperial doctors found the right prescription?"
"I don't know whether the imperial doctor's prescription is right,"
Zhou Liupei blinked, "But it was spread in the palace that it was Princess Lian who found an ancient prescription from somewhere and presented it to the Queen, and the disease was cured by the medicine.
Moreover, after the Empress recovered from her illness, she went to Cining Palace early yesterday morning to pay her respects to the Queen Mother, and she looked even better than before her illness!
The Queen Mother was very happy and rewarded many things. "
Li Yeqing listened silently, as he expected this.
"This is the second one,"
Zhou Liupei lowered his voice and said, "It has something to do with the person from Changchun Palace. Guess what? At the scripture banquet lecture a few days ago, His Royal Highness the Third Prince asked the lecturer Lao Hanlin for medical allusions in ancient books. Somehow, he talked about some rare medicinal materials and prescriptions with strong medicinal properties that can cause people to have symptoms of hot and cold. Although he didn't mention who it was, several old ministers present at the time, as well as His Majesty, were all listening!
Then he presented a prescription he had found, saying that by mixing herbs based on it, he could get a pill that increases blood energy. Although it was painful, it could improve the strength of the warrior.
He was highly praised by the emperor, and it is said that he was promoted to the title of prince on the spot. "
Li Yeqing tapped his fingertips lightly on the table.
Ji Zhao's actions were not slow, and his method was very clever. During the banquet, he used the name of academic discussion to convey the message of "specific symptoms and specific medicines" intentionally, seemingly unintentionally.
As long as the emperor is not too stupid, he will definitely be impressed in his heart.
"Then what? What's the reaction from Changchun Palace?"
"Reaction?" Zhou Liupei curled his lips,
"There doesn't seem to be any reaction."
Is this cleaning up the traces or speeding up action?
Li Yeqing thought to himself.
Concubine Duan was obviously aware of the risk and began to deal with it.
All I can say is that she is worthy of being Concubine Duan, even though the other party has already reached this point, she is still taking her time and acting in a secretive manner.
